name: Detect Magic
description:
Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

While this spell is active, you sense the presence of magic within short range.

If you sense magic in this way, you may use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in range that bears magic. The color of the aura gives you a vague sense of the nature of the magic.

Each time you do this, roll Lore to see if you trigger any additional effects.

Describe how you sense magic around you.
successes:
✨: The range of this spell increases to medium.

🌞: You learn which spells are currently effecting the creature or object.

💀: Your probing senses reach too far. Hostile creatures within long range are alerted to your presence, though not your precise location. Check a condition.
